name: odoo-mcp
description: Search, create, read, update, and delete Odoo records via XML-RPC
long_description: An MCP bundle that exposes Odoo's XML-RPC API to MCP-aware hosts. Tools cover the full CRUD surface (search_read, search_ids, search_count, read_record, create_record, update_record, delete_record) plus schema discovery (list_models, get_model_fields). Authentication uses an Odoo API key, which is required when the user account has 2FA enabled. Errors are enriched with classification and fuzzy field/model name suggestions to help LLMs recover from typos.

tools.name: search_read
tools.description: Search and read records matching an Odoo domain

tools.name: search_ids
tools.description: Search for record IDs matching an Odoo domain

tools.name: search_count
tools.description: Count records matching an Odoo domain

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List available Odoo models, optionally filtered

tools.name: get_model_fields
tools.description: Get field metadata for a model
